choice: git_head runs `git symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD`: exit 0 gives the branch, exit 1 means a detached HEAD, anything else means no repository.
context: The panel called a freshly initialized repository 'not a git repository'.
rejected: `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`: fails on an unborn branch and cannot tell that case from a missing repository.
title: `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` fails in a repository without commits
